svg.title: Replicated forcing memory per node
svg.desc: Line chart of the product of MPI ranks per node and the median peak resident memory of one rank, in GiB, against MPI ranks per node, one line per suite, with horizontal lines for physical node memory and the scheduler's default job memory. Each rank holds the full forcing, so the product is an estimate of node demand, not a measured node total. Computational diagnostic; no confidence intervals.
